summary: Nixxy, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered direct offering of 484,375 shares of common stock at $0.64 per share, for total proceeds of $310,000. The price represents a 23.8% discount to the prior closing price of $0.84. The offering is being made under an existing shelf registration statement. The shares trade on Nasdaq under symbol NIXX. Delivery is expected on June 8, 2026. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine at-the-market or registered direct offering by the issuer for capital-raising purposes. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal-specific structural features are mentioned.
